import pandas as pd
import sqlite3

print(f"Hero IDs with death touch (power_id=37): {list(heroes_with_death_touch)}")

# Now query the superhero.db to get names
conn = sqlite3.connect('db/superhero.db')
query = f"""
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE id IN ({','.join(map(str, heroes_with_death_touch))})
"""
names_df = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)
conn.close()

print("\nSuperhero names:")
for name in names_df['superhero_name']:
